title: 写作表达库
intro: 写作专用的句型/连接/套话，按功能场景分组。考场直接调用。点 🔊 朗读 · 背记模式遮中文 · 掌握进度本地保存。每次考拉考拉练完把想留的表达发我，说「写作表达库加：<表达>」即可累进。

items.usage: 最稳的立场开头，中性正式

ex.en: In my opinion, online classes offer more flexibility.
ex.zh: 在我看来，网课更灵活。

ex.en: I believe that libraries are still essential.
ex.zh: 我认为图书馆仍然不可或缺。

ex.en: From my perspective, both sides have valid points.
ex.zh: 在我看来，双方都有道理。

scenes.name: ② 让步认可（让步型开头）

items.usage: 让步型第 1 句，先认可一位同学

ex.en: Admittedly, Paul is right when he says sports improve health.
ex.zh: 诚然，Paul 说运动有益健康是对的。

ex.en: It is true that free transport could reduce traffic.
ex.zh: 确实，免费交通能减少拥堵。

items.usage: 让步型第 2 句，补让步理由

ex.en: After all, many students rely on part-time jobs.
ex.zh: 毕竟，许多学生靠兼职生活。

items.usage: 让步型第 3 句，转折提出己见（高级）

ex.en: Nevertheless, I think academics should come first.
ex.zh: 然而，我认为学业应当优先。

ex.en: However, this approach has clear limits.
ex.zh: 然而，这种做法有明显局限。

ex.en: That said, cost remains a real concern.
ex.zh: 话虽如此，成本仍是个现实问题。

ex.en: On the other hand, some students prefer in-person classes.
ex.zh: 另一方面，有些学生更喜欢面授。

ex.en: One important reason is that it saves commuting time.
ex.zh: 一个重要原因是它省下通勤时间。

ex.en: This is because access to resources shapes learning.
ex.zh: 这是因为资源获取影响学习。

items.usage: 让步型第 4 句：给新的支持理由

ex.en: In my opinion, a new library could strengthen academic exchange.
ex.zh: 在我看来，新图书馆能加强学术交流。

items.usage: 最常用举例，后接具体例子

ex.en: For example, when I studied abroad, I relied on the library daily.
ex.zh: 例如，我留学时每天都靠图书馆。

ex.en: For instance, many campuses now offer hybrid courses.
ex.zh: 比如，许多校园现在提供混合课程。

items.en: A good example of this is ...

ex.en: A good example of this is the shift to remote work.
ex.zh: 一个很好的例子是转向远程办公。

items.usage: 让步型第 5 句：换个说法解释

ex.en: In other words, quality matters more than quantity.
ex.zh: 换句话说，质比量更重要。

ex.en: That is to say, we should focus on outcomes.
ex.zh: 也就是说，我们应关注结果。

items.usage: 让步型第 7 句：得出结论

ex.en: Therefore, I believe the library should come first.
ex.zh: 因此，我认为应优先建图书馆。

ex.en: For these reasons, I support the new policy.
ex.zh: 出于这些原因，我支持这项新政策。

ex.en: Overall, the benefits outweigh the costs.
ex.zh: 总的来说，利大于弊。

items.en: I hope you are doing well.
items.usage: 邮件第 2 句·问候（几乎必用）

ex.en: Dear Professor, I hope you are doing well.
ex.zh: 尊敬的教授，希望您一切都好。

ex.en: I am writing to ask about the deadline for the essay.
ex.zh: 我写信是想询问论文的截止日期。

ex.en: I am reaching out regarding my recent application.
ex.zh: 我就我最近的申请联系您。

items.en: I would appreciate it if you could ...
items.zh: 如果您能……我将不胜感激

ex.en: I would appreciate it if you could send me the lecture notes.
ex.zh: 如果您能把讲义发我，我将不胜感激。

ex.en: Would it be possible to reschedule the meeting?
ex.zh: 是否可以改期开会？

items.en: Could you please let me know if ...?

ex.en: Could you please let me know if my submission was received?
ex.zh: 能否请您告知我的提交是否收到？

items.en: I would love to meet with you to discuss ... and explore how we can work together.
items.zh: 我很愿意与您见面讨论……并探讨我们如何合作
items.usage: 礼貌提出见面+合作（募捐信积累）

ex.en: I would love to meet with you to discuss the plans and explore how we can work together.
ex.zh: 我很愿意与您见面讨论方案，并探讨我们如何合作。

items.en: Please let me know if you have a preferred time to ...
items.usage: 请对方给时间，周到（募捐信积累）

ex.en: Please let me know if you have a preferred time to talk on Saturday or Sunday.
ex.zh: 请告知您周六或周日方便通话的时间。

items.en: Thank you for your time and assistance.

ex.en: Thank you for your time and assistance.
ex.zh: 感谢您的时间与帮助。

items.en: I look forward to hearing from you.

ex.en: I look forward to hearing from you.
ex.zh: 期待您的回复。

items.en: Please let me know if you need any further information.
items.zh: 如需更多信息请告知我。

ex.en: Please let me know if you need any further information.
ex.zh: 如需更多信息请告知我。

items.en: I look forward to hearing your thoughts on ...
items.usage: 收尾·邀对方回应观点，比 hearing from you 更具体（募捐信积累）

ex.en: I look forward to hearing your thoughts on this meaningful project.
ex.zh: 期待听到您对这个有意义的项目的看法。

scenes.name: ⑪ 邮件·陈述目的/优势

items.usage: 说明活动目的，把「好处」具体化（募捐信积累）

ex.en: This initiative aims to provide essential medical resources for families in need.
ex.zh: 这项活动旨在为困难家庭提供必需的医疗资源。

items.en: I am optimistic that ... will be successful because ...
items.usage: 表明信心并给理由，比「everybody knows」有力（募捐信积累）

ex.en: I am optimistic that this event will be successful because there is a strong sense of community here.
ex.zh: 我相信这次活动会成功，因为这里有很强的社区凝聚力。

items.en: My background in both A and B allows me to offer unique insights into ...
items.zh: 我在 A 和 B 两方面的背景让我能为……提供独到见解
items.usage: 陈述个人优势/为何能帮上忙（募捐信积累）

ex.en: My background in both healthcare and finance allows me to offer unique insights into planning the event.
ex.zh: 我在医疗和财务两方面的背景让我能为活动策划提供独到见解。
